scenarios.expected: Tampering must not reproduce the sender's shared secret.
scenarios.observed: Implicit rejection produced a different receiver secret.
scenarios.title: Tampered hybrid KEM ciphertext

scenarios.expected: Unsupported versions and suite substitution must raise FormatError.
scenarios.title: Protocol version and algorithm downgrade

scenarios.expected: A substituted recipient key must have a different fingerprint and fail key agreement.
scenarios.observed: Fingerprint mismatch detected; substituted recipient derived a different secret.
scenarios.title: Recipient public-key substitution

scenarios.expected: Verification must fail if either ML-DSA or ECDSA is absent.
scenarios.observed: PQ component rejected=True; classical component rejected=True.
scenarios.title: Hybrid signature component stripping

scenarios.expected: Reordered authenticated records must fail authentication.
scenarios.title: Encrypted chunk reordering

scenarios.expected: A missing final authentication tag must reject the complete stream.
scenarios.title: Authenticated final-record truncation

scenarios.expected: Every malformed corpus input must be rejected without an unhandled parser exception.
scenarios.observed: 10/10 malformed inputs rejected; fuzz target caps input at 1 MiB and plaintext at 8 MiB.
scenarios.title: Bounded malformed-envelope parser corpus
